# ECO360

> The compliance and carbon data layer for physical products. Product-level CO₂,
> substance screening and digital product passports. Every figure carries a
> confidence tier. Operated by EcoGreen360 Oy, Finland.

## What ECO360 does
- Product carbon footprints at model level, with the calculation tier stated
- Bill-of-materials screening for RoHS, REACH and POPs
- Digital Product Passport data
- GHG Scope 1/2/3 reporting from the same loaded data
- Delivered as an API, a console, an embeddable product card, or an agent
